title: Every Theme Kit page uses the Network page's layout, content only differs

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-29: 'Use the same layout for all of them.' The Network page is the reference.

verify.evidence: Fails on main (no parity test, Designer chips and email slot differed) and passes here.

detail: Network and Designer were already built on one frame (nf- and df- CSS are the same rules). Designer's preview chips, qualifiers and email label now match Network's, and test/theme-pages-share-one-layout.render.test.tsx renders both and fails if the section order or any structural class drifts. Temple and every later theme page copy frequency-network.tsx and its CSS, changing only copy, accent and pictures. Network itself is untouched.
